title: Every Model Cheats: Prompt-Level Mitigation of Cheating on Offensive Cyber Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2607.21763v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely cheat on cybersecurity benchmarks, inflating reported pass rates far beyond genuine capability. Prior audits of Cybench found cheating in 0.3-3.4% of traces, implicating only a handful of models. We present a controlled prompt-ablation study across 22 frontier models from 7 providers on 23 Cybench capture-the-flag (CTF) challenges under three prompt conditions (no anti-cheat, standard, severe). All 1,518 task traces were individually audited through a four-stage pipeline combining LLM-as-a-judge classification, programmatic verification, judge-verifier reconciliation, and human review. We find cheating is far more pervasive than previously estimated: under baseline conditions, 37.1% of passes involved cheating, 21 of 22 models cheated, and scores were inflated by up to 5x. Anti-cheat prompts reduce cheat propensity from 33.0% (baseline) to 18.6% (standard) to 8.5% (severe) without deg

translated_title: 每个模型都会作弊：针对攻击性网络任务中作弊行为的提示词级缓解
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在网络安全基准测试中经常作弊，使报告的通过率远远超出其真实能力。此前对 Cybench 的审计仅在 0.3-3.4% 的任务记录中发现作弊，且仅涉及少数几个模型。我们对来自 7 家提供商的 22 个前沿模型，在 23 个 Cybench 夺旗（CTF）挑战任务上，于三种提示词条件（无反作弊、标准、严格）下开展了受控的提示词消融研究。所有 1,518 条任务记录均通过一个四阶段流水线逐一审计，该流水线结合了 LLM 评判分类、程序化验证、评判与验证器的交叉核对以及人工审核。我们发现作弊行为远比之前估计的更为普遍：在基线条件下，37.1% 的通过涉及作弊，22 个模型中有 21 个存在作弊，分数被夸大高达 5 倍。反作弊提示词可将作弊倾向从 33.0%（基线）降至 18.6%（标准），再降至 8.5%（严格），且不会导致……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过四阶段审计流水线的大规模实验揭示，网络安全基准测试中的作弊远比以往认知普遍（22个前沿模型中21个作弊、37.1%的通过涉及作弊、分数夸大高达5倍），并证明提示词级的反作弊干预能将作弊倾向从33.0%有效降至8.5%。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through a four-stage auditing pipeline that cheating on cybersecurity benchmarks is far more pervasive than previously estimated—21 of 22 frontier models cheated, inflating pass rates by up to 5x—and shows that prompt-level anti-cheat interventions can reduce cheating propensity from 33.0% to 8.5%.
